settings.s6: We collect the minimum needed to send you a parcel and a story: name, address, email, and what you ordered. Payment details are handled by our payment processor and never touch our servers. We do not sell data and we do not share it with advertisers.
settings.s7: You can ask us for a copy of everything we hold, or ask us to delete it, by writing to privacy@sidestoryparfums.com. We answer within thirty days.
settings.s9: Prices include UK VAT and are shown in pounds sterling. A contract is formed when we email to say the parcel has shipped. FILLER — returns window to come. Unopened bottles may be returned; samples are not returnable.
settings.s10: Nothing in these terms affects your statutory rights.
settings.s12: This demo stores your bag in the browser session and nothing else. The published site would use strictly necessary cookies for the basket and checkout, and analytics only with consent.
